notes: Etcd3gw 2.7.0 is an OpenStack-maintained third-party etcd v3 gRPC-gateway client. The adapter implements Range/Txn/Lease only; read-only operations may try another configured endpoint after transport failure, while mutating operations are sent once to preserve unknown-outcome semantics. Ten fake-gateway contract unit tests are in default CI. Five live cluster tests are opt-in and were not run in this round. The Compose topology is plaintext local-only and not a production profile. Watch remains unavailable until a driver preserves the complete server response envelope. Existing SQLite business service is not migrated; schema-v2 remains sole production authority. Final code commit 871fe0d2673fb1b39502236568dc7dd57ad3bef0 passed both required jobs in CI Run 45832644686: 499 tests completed (494 passed, 5 opt-in live-etcd tests skipped), CH12 143 numerical tests passed, strict knowledge lint 0 errors; separate CH17 fixture validator 0 errors/5 expected governance warnings; the separate CH17 synthetic fixture validator passed with 0 errors and 5 existing governance warnings (DRAFT dataset, no approved enterprise environment or level, 30 SPAT source cases NOT_RUN, and manifest checksum pending). No live etcd cluster was started; skipped tests are not integration evidence.
